apps.coverage_note: Initial reading of one 50-review Android stream, ten selected historical Apple excerpts and two news items, kept separate. Not a complete cross-platform, longitudinal or news-sentiment census. Reports do not automatically change a design assessment.

review_sample.selection: 50 newest returned written reviews; self-selected, not representative. Requested language does not guarantee review language or residency.

news.title: Sponsorship and audience trust
news.summary: RNS reported both criticism and support for Hallow’s Lenten sponsorship of Tucker Carlson’s programme. The report said Hallow had not responded by publication. This is context for audience trust and partner selection, not evidence about the app’s checkout or all users’ views.

news.title: Religious chatbots in wider coverage
news.summary: Hallow’s popularity appears in wider chatbot coverage; general concerns are not Hallow-specific findings.

review_themes.label: Use cases
review_themes.summary: Commuting prayer, a daily routine, learning Catholic practices and returning to faith appear in the sample.

review_themes.label: Reported benefit
review_themes.summary: Some reviewers describe encouragement, valued content and a stronger prayer habit. These are personal reports, not measured spiritual outcomes.

review_themes.label: Access and billing friction
review_themes.summary: Reviewers question affordability, finding free content, trial payment requirements and cancellation. Publisher documentation describes a free tier; these reports are prompts to test discoverability and billing, not proof every user must pay.

review_themes.label: Reliability and continuity
review_themes.summary: Reports include battery drain, playback or cache problems, account access and lost saved content. One reviewer links a lost streak to connectivity while travelling; this warrants checking recovery without establishing coercion.

apple_reading.selection: Public page default order; selected historical excerpts, not a recent or representative sample. One excerpt describes downloading before using the app.
apple_reading.summary: Older excerpts value guided prayer, learning and family routines; they request transcripts and report account/payment problems. Our later capture shows a transcript for one prayer, so historical requests are not proof of a current omission.

apps.coverage_note: Reviewed one 50-item Android stream, ten selected Apple excerpts and three dated reporting/publisher-context sources separately. Broader search excluded unrelated Dwell magazine results and unverified automated sentiment claims. This is bounded coverage, not an internet-sentiment census.

review_sample.selection: 50 newest returned written reviews; self-selected, not representative. Locale requests do not establish residence.

news.title: Audio listening in everyday life
news.summary: The report interviews Dwell’s cofounder within wider coverage of audio Bibles, everyday listening and the complementary roles of audio and text. It provides historical use-case context, not a causal study of Dwell’s spiritual impact.

news.title: NeuBible acquisition
news.summary: Dwell announced its acquisition of NeuBible and described a shared emphasis on reading design. The announcement said integration was not in place then; it does not establish the products’ current relationship.

news.title: Human, hybrid and generated voices
news.summary: The publisher describes human studio recordings, recordings extended with TTS, and fully generated voices. It says fully generated voices are labelled Digital Voice in the app. Production and current in-app labelling have not been independently audited here.

review_themes.label: Everyday listening
review_themes.summary: Commuting, household tasks, morning reflection and bedtime listening recur as use cases. Reported spiritual benefit remains personal testimony rather than a measured outcome.

review_themes.label: Choice and preference
review_themes.summary: Reviewers value narrator, translation and background-music choices. Some want more control or sleep content; individual preferences differ.

review_themes.label: Access and prompting friction
review_themes.summary: Affordability, expected free access, cancellation and repeated account/notification prompts appear as pain points. Publisher-documented samples and paid offers do not establish how easy those paths are to discover or exit.

review_themes.label: Reliability and platform expectations
review_themes.summary: Reports include crashes, a blank screen, Android feature delays and sign-in/in-car needs. These are scoped test cases, not reproduced findings or claims about every version.

apple_reading.selection: Public-page default order; selected excerpts across several years, not a recent or representative sample.
apple_reading.summary: Selected excerpts value repeat listening, reflection, read-along and family routines. Reported friction includes offline startup, text/audio alignment and support routes. An edited voice review illustrates why subjective impressions need checking against the publisher’s current voice categories.

apps.coverage_note: Thematic reading includes all 50 returned Android reviews; the statistics below use a 180-day window and may count fewer. Ten historical Apple excerpts and three dated/checked context sources are kept separate. No medical outcome, overall sentiment score or app-wide moral judgment is inferred.

review_sample.selection: 50 newest returned written reviews, including two older than the 180-day statistics window. Self-selected; locale requests do not establish residency.

news.title: Guideposts acquisition
news.summary: The report describes Guideposts’ acquisition of Abide and says transaction terms were undisclosed. Its historical audience numbers span distribution channels; they should not be presented as current app users or revenue.

news.title: Free access and financial assistance
news.summary: Publisher help describes the short daily meditation and selected sleep stories as free, with premium subscriptions and request-based discounts or one-year assistance. The offer’s existence does not establish approval rates or fulfilment for individual applicants.

news.title: Donor-supported access programme
news.summary: The undated programme page invites support for subscriptions for military members, students, chaplains, pastors and underserved people. This documents the advertised mechanism; distribution, donor costs and outcomes have not been independently verified.

review_themes.label: Quiet routines
review_themes.summary: Morning reflection, bedtime listening and encouragement are valued uses. Reports of calm and sleep benefit are personal experiences, not evidence of clinical effectiveness.

review_themes.label: Access and affordability
review_themes.summary: Reviewers describe cost concerns, confusing paid-access/sign-in states, restoration problems and difficulty managing renewal. These are investigation targets, not verified billing misconduct.

review_themes.label: Reliability and interruption
review_themes.summary: Reported crashes, navigation delays, overnight playback and loud alarm/prompt problems can undermine a calming session. Platform, version and settings need reproduction before judging prevalence or mechanism.

review_themes.label: Content and preference
review_themes.summary: Children’s sleep-content requests, narrator preferences and responses to meditation wording vary. A subjective claim that a voice is generated does not establish its production method.

apple_reading.selection: Public-page default order; selected historical excerpts, not a recent or representative sample.
apple_reading.summary: Selected excerpts value Scripture routines, sleep listening and family use. Others object to paid boundaries or describe prompts disrupting reflection; older requests for gentler ending and playlist controls are test questions, not confirmed current omissions. Sensitive personal testimony is not reproduced or treated as medical evidence.
